AD.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180; passport must stay valid at least 3 months after you leave Andorra.

AE.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days; for tourism the passport must have at least 6 months validity left.

AF.note: Visa required in advance from an Afghan mission; none on arrival; no stay length stated.

AG.note: No visa for visits of up to 90 days within 180 days.

AL.note: Visa-free for 90 days within 180 days counted from first entry; ID card also accepted.

AM.note: Visa-free for up to 180 days within one year (read as 180 in any 365 days).

AO.note: Visa required for ordinary passports; passport must be valid for more than 6 months; no stay length stated.

AR.note: Page says both 3 months and 90 days for tourist stays; counted here as 90 in any 180 (stricter reading).

AU.note: Visa required before travel; types and stay length are in the Australian visa finder.

AZ.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days; entry by air only because land borders are closed to Serbian citizens.

BA.note: No visa; up to 90 days counted from entry; ID card or passport accepted (children need a passport).

BB.note: No visa for a stay of up to 90 days.

BD.note: Visa required in advance (Serbian page names the Bangladesh embassy in Rome); passport valid 6 months; no stay length stated.

BF.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BH.note: A visa is required and can be applied for online as an e-visa; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BI.note: A visa is required (from the Burundi embassy in Paris); the Serbian page states no length of stay for ordinary passports.

BJ.note: A visa is required (apply on the official e-visa site); the Serbian page states no length of stay for ordinary passports.

BN.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BO.note: A visa from a Bolivian mission is required; the stay may be extended up to 180 days in a single year (initial stay not stated).

BR.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days, extendable by 90, but no more than 180 days per year counted from first entry; work is not allowed.

BT.note: A visa is required and is arranged through a registered Bhutanese tour agency; no stay length stated.

BW.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BY.note: Visa-free for up to 30 days per stay and 90 days per calendar year; longer stays need a visa.

BZ.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

NP.note: Tourist visa on arrival (15/30/90 days, extendable); at most 150 days per calendar year (January–December).

TR.note: Up to 90 days in a period of 6 months counted from the first entry (counted here as 90 in any 180, the stricter reading). Passport valid 150 days from entry.

_comment: Hand-checked rules that replace the passport-index defaults. Key: passport ISO code, then destination ISO code (or SCHENGEN). Every entry needs src (official page) and checked (YYYY-MM-DD). The twice-yearly routine extends this to every destination.
